s.note: King prawns in garlic, chilli and lemon, grilled hot on skewers over the coals
s.how: Toss 600g peeled king prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, lemon zest and 2 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill hot for 90 seconds a side. Brush with 50g butter melted with 1 tsp lemon myrtle and serve with lemon.

s.n: Street cart hot dogs with sauerkraut
s.note: Frankfurts in soft rolls with mustard, sauerkraut and fried onion, off the cart.
s.how: Fry 2 sliced onions in 1 tbsp oil for 15 minutes until soft and golden. Simmer 8 frankfurts in hot water for 6 minutes, or grill until browned. Warm 8 soft hot dog rolls and fill with a frankfurt, onion, 200g drained sauerkraut and yellow mustard, with extra mustard and tomato sauce to pass around.

m.note: Crisp-skin barra, grilled. Stay clear of the billabong.
m.how: Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets and pat very dry. Grill skin down over high heat until crisp, about 4 minutes, then flip for 1 minute. Melt 80g butter with 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp lemon myrtle and spoon over.

w.note: Baked cheesecake on a biscuit base, with a warm berry sauce.
w.how: Crush 250g plain sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a 22cm springform tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 180g sugar, then beat in 3 eggs one at a time, 200g sour cream, 1 tsp vanilla and the juice of half a lemon until smooth. Pour over the base and bake at 160C for 55 minutes until set with a slight wobble, then turn off the oven and cool inside for 30 minutes. Chill at least 3 hours. Simmer 300g frozen berries with 2 tbsp sugar for 6 minutes and spoon over each slice.

d.n: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer
d.note: Dark rum and ginger beer over ice
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 150ml chilled ginger beer. Slowly pour 45ml dark rum over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.
